story.title: A family-friendly Legacy Run supporting care, research, and Amanda's memorial scholarship.
paragraphs: The Amanda Pair Foundation Legacy Run presented by Alabama Oncology returns to Birmingham on Saturday, November 14, 2026 for its 5th annual race morning.

Named for Amanda Pair, a beloved wife, mother, friend, and community member who courageously battled lung cancer until her death at age 40 in June 2022, the Foundation works to overcome cancer through caring for families, funding research, and investing in the next generation.

The majority of proceeds from the Legacy Run are directed to a memorial scholarship created in Amanda's memory by the Foundation and the Vestavia Hills Elementary Liberty Park PTO, awarded annually to a senior VHELP alumni at VHHS through 2035.
